summary: Reversible Tools UX/UI header maturity release. V2.47.212 rebuilds the local Professional Toolbox selector as a contained rounded navigation surface, compacts and balances the toolbox context hero, aligns the sticky workflow navigation to the same visual grammar, adds scroll-synchronized current workflow state, and improves quick-task menu dismissal. This release is built directly from the Owner-confirmed V2.47.209 production baseline so the backend can offer one-step upgrade without requiring V2.47.211 first. Canonical Start URL/category/tag authority, Schema/migrations, auth/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state and Production runtime are unchanged. Production remains Owner-manual.
